Rotation guides

What each rotation does, in priority order, plus every option in its settings panel. Sliders marked effective count heals already on the way; real HP is the actual health bar.

Restoration Mythic+

Healer · Wildstalker
Download .yaml All rotations

A Mythic+ healer built around three things: Abundance kept stacked with Rejuvenation, Everbloom Lifebloom, and Convoke the Spirits as the big group cooldown. When the group is healthy it turns the spare globals into damage.

Build: Wildstalker, with Convoke, Everbloom, Soul of the Forest, Germination, Abundance, Nature's Swiftness, Ironbark, Fluid Form and Heart of the Wild. Copy the string from Talents → Recommended Talent String in the rotation panel.

Before the key

  • Set Lifebloom Target to Self for the Everbloom setup, or Tank if you prefer it there.
  • Out of combat the rotation tops everyone up, bonds the tank with Symbiotic Relationship, refreshes Mark of the Wild and pre-casts Rejuvenation, so every pull starts with Abundance already stacked.

How it heals

After defensives, the rotation checks these in order and casts the first one that applies:

  1. Lifebloom upkeep with Everbloom. While anyone is below Regrowth Emergency HP, Lifebloom waits until it has 2 seconds left so the emergency heals go first.
  2. Nature's Swiftness followed by an instant, empowered Regrowth on the lowest ally under the Nature's Swiftness threshold.
  3. Convoke the Spirits, Tranquility and Swiftmend (see Cooldowns).
  4. Mouseover emergency healing when you hover a low ally's frame (see Utility).
  5. Abundance upkeep: your own Rejuvenation and Germination, and enough Rejuvenations around the group to keep at least 5 lasting, so Abundance never drops.
  6. Emergency Regrowth on anyone below Regrowth Emergency HP (real health).
  7. Clearcasting and Soul of the Forest Regrowth, Soul of the Forest Rejuvenation and Germination.
  8. Wild Growth once enough allies are below the Wild Growth threshold.
  9. Abundance Regrowth, then Rejuvenation and Germination on anyone who needs them, and plain Regrowth as the filler.

While moving it only uses instants: Rejuvenation, Germination and the Abundance upkeep.

Cooldowns

  • Convoke the Spirits goes out when enough allies (the tank does not count) are below the Convoke threshold. Trinkets, Berserking and the combat potion fire right before it. If you are in Bear, Cat or Moonkin Form it casts a Rejuvenation first to leave the form: Convoke is never cast in an animal form, because there it rolls that form's spells instead of heals.
  • Tranquility when enough allies (tank excluded) are low and you are standing still. Tick Manual Tranquility to press it yourself.
  • Swiftmend on cooldown on someone with a HoT, feeding Soul of the Forest and Everbloom.

Defense

  • Barkskin before a big hit lands: it reads your health minus the biggest predicted incoming hit.
  • Ironbark on the tank, or on anyone if you change Ironbark Target.
  • Panic Bear: at very low health it shifts to Bear Form for Frenzied Regeneration.
  • Healthstone and health potion at their thresholds.
  • While casting, below Emergency HP, Barkskin and the consumables still fire, and a hardcast can be cut to free the global for a defensive. Channels are never cut: during Convoke only Barkskin fires, during Tranquility nothing does.

Utility

  • Nature's Cure on any dispellable ally, plus the Devouring Rift affix.
  • Soothe on an enraged target or whatever enraged enemy you hover.
  • Mouseover emergency healing: hover an ally's frame below the mouseover threshold and it gets Swiftmend, Rejuvenation and Regrowth first.
  • Rebirth in combat and Revitalize out of combat on the dead ally under your mouse.
  • Temple of Sethraliss: hover the Avatar to heal it.
  • Roots are broken by shapeshifting, never in the middle of a cast or channel.
  • Racials: Shadowmeld to drop aggro, Berserking with Convoke, Darkflight after 2 seconds of running.

Damage

When the most injured ally is above DPS Group HP, spare globals go to Starsurge, Sunfire, Moonfire and Starfire, with Heart of the Wild for the Moonkin burst.

Hotkey toggles

Both start off and reset when you reload.

  • Force DPS Only: stops all proactive healing and goes pure damage. Defensives and consumables still fire.
  • Disable Nature's Swiftness: holds Nature's Swiftness for when you want it.

Effective health counts heals already on the way; real HP is the actual health bar. Emergencies and defensives read real HP.

Restoration Raid

Healer · Wildstalker with Reforestation
Download .yaml All rotations

A raid healer that keeps Abundance and Everbloom rolling, spends Convoke and Tranquility on real group damage, and makes the most of the Tree of Life windows from Reforestation. Damage only when the raid is healthy.

Build: Wildstalker with Reforestation, Flourish, Innervate, Everbloom, Soul of the Forest, Germination and Abundance. Copy the string from Talents → Recommended Talent String in the rotation panel.

Tree of Life (Reforestation)

Every fourth Swiftmend turns you into a tree for a few seconds. The rotation detects it and casts Wild Growth and instant Regrowths during the window. Panic Bear and root breaking never shift you out of it.

Pre-stacking: out of combat it Swiftmends a HoT target until Reforestation shows 3 stacks, so the first Swiftmend of the next pull makes you a tree. This works on trash. When a boss encounter starts the game resets the counter, so on bosses cast the 4th Swiftmend yourself 1 to 2 seconds before the pull: the tree carries into combat. Turn it off with Pre-stack Reforestation.

How it heals

Defensives and cooldowns are checked first. Then the healing list runs in this order:

  1. Emergency Regrowth on anyone below Regrowth Emergency HP (real health), above every other heal.
  2. Tree of Life Wild Growth and instant Regrowth while you are a tree.
  3. Your own Rejuvenation and Germination kept up.
  4. Soul of the Forest Regrowth, Rejuvenation and Germination.
  5. Lifebloom with Everbloom on you or on the tank.
  6. Abundance Regrowth, Wild Growth by number of injured, Clearcasting Regrowth.
  7. Rejuvenation and Germination on injured allies, then Regrowth as the filler.

Abundance upkeep keeps at least 5 Rejuvenations lasting. While moving it only uses instants.

Cooldowns

  • Nature's Swiftness with an instant Regrowth on the lowest ally.
  • Convoke the Spirits when enough allies in range are below the Convoke threshold. Trinkets and the combat potion go first, and it leaves any animal form before casting.
  • Tranquility automatic when enough allies are low, or manual with Manual Tranquility.
  • Swiftmend on cooldown, tree form included, since it also builds Reforestation.
  • Thorn Bloom (racial) when enough allies are hurt, Innervate on yourself at your mana threshold.

Defense

  • Barkskin before a predicted hit, Ironbark on the tank or anyone, Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration.
  • Healthstone and health potion, also while casting, but never during Convoke or Tranquility.

Utility

  • Nature's Cure, Soothe on target and mouseover, Mark of the Wild out of combat and at low priority in combat.
  • Mouseover emergency healing, Rebirth and Revitalize on the dead ally under your mouse.
  • Roots broken by shapeshifting, never mid-cast.

Damage

Starsurge, Moonfire and Starfire while fewer than DPS - Max Injured allies are below DPS Group HP.

Hotkey toggle

  • Disable Nature's Swiftness: holds Nature's Swiftness for when you want it.

Symbiotic Relationship is not cast by the raid rotation: bond whoever you want by hand.

Guardian Mythic+

Tank · Elune's Chosen with Lunar Calling
Download .yaml All rotations

A Mythic+ tank that puts survival first. Defensives react to the predicted next hit instead of waiting for your health to drop, rage is split between Ironfur and Maul by how much damage is coming, and the Heart of the Wild cat weave only happens when it is safe.

Build: Elune's Chosen with Lunar Calling, Lunation, Galactic Guardian, Incarnation and Heart of the Wild. Copy the string from Talents → Recommended Talent String in the rotation panel.

Survival

  • Ironfur to keep it up, whenever the predicted incoming hit is at least Ironfur over Maul % of your health, and before rage caps. Gory Fur procs (cheaper Ironfur) are spent right away.
  • Barkskin and Survival Instincts fire when your health minus the predicted hit (after your active defensives) would fall below their thresholds, with plain HP versions as a backstop.
  • Tank busters: Barkskin is held for the next tank buster on the Encounter Timeline, and in Mythic+ it is not spent on a pack about to die (except on the last boss).
  • Frenzied Regeneration counts heals already flying at you, so it does not waste a charge on a dip your healer is covering.
  • Healthstone and health potion at their thresholds.

Damage

  • Lunar Calling turns Thrash into a Moonfire generator. Moonfire also goes out on Galactic Guardian procs and through Lunation.
  • Thrash to max stacks, Mangle without capping rage, Maul when rage is close to the cap and no heavy hit is coming.
  • Lunar Beam only while standing, Wild Guardian during Lunar Beam.
  • Incarnation with trinkets and the combat potion.

Heart of the Wild weave

The rotation shifts to Cat Form, fires Heart of the Wild (Feral Frenzy) and returns to Bear, but only when all of these are true:

  • you have been in combat for the HotW delay and standing still for a moment;
  • your health is above the HotW minimum and no heavy hit is predicted;
  • no tank buster is due within the tank buster window;
  • the target will live long enough.

Incarnation waits for the weave only through the delay at the pull plus Max Wait. After that it goes, and the weave waits for Incarnation to end.

Utility

  • Growl anything that is not attacking you (never in a raid, where it would steal a boss).
  • Skull Bash on target, mouseover and focus, plus AoE stuns and incapacitates.
  • Moonfire on mouseover enemies in combat. Pull with Mouseover Moonfire exists but ships off: with it on, hovering any enemy nameplate pulls it.
  • Remove Corruption on yourself (and the party if enabled), Soothe, Rebirth on mouseover.
  • Roots are broken by shifting to Cat and back, but only when it is safe: 3 or more Ironfur stacks, above 90% health and Barkskin or Survival Instincts up.

Rage
Ironfur over Maul - Incoming Damage %20When the biggest predicted incoming hit, after active defensives, is at least this % of your health, rage goes to Ironfur and Maul waits. The same check also blocks the HotW weave.
Maul - Rage Deficit20Maul fires once rage is within this much of the cap, while Ironfur is up and no heavy hit is predicted. Higher = Maul sooner.
Cooldowns
Auto Heart of the WildOnWeave Cat Form, Heart of the Wild, then back to Bear Form automatically when HotW is ready.
Heart of the Wild - Delay After Pull8Seconds of combat required before leaving Bear Form for the HotW weave.
Incarnation - Max Wait for Heart of the Wild4Incarnation/Berserk wait for the HotW weave through the HotW delay at the pull plus this many seconds. After that, if the weave is blocked (moving, low HP, heavy damage predicted, tank buster soon, target dying), Incarnation goes and HotW waits for it to end. 0 = wait only the HotW delay.
Heart of the Wild - Minimum HP % (real HP)80Stay in Bear Form below this health. Leaving Bear drops bear armor and stamina.
Heart of the Wild - Min Standing Still2Seconds standing still before the weave may fire. The morph is Feral Frenzy, a 5 yard melee hit that channels five ticks over roughly a second - start it while still repositioning and you either leave range mid-channel or spend the window walking. Standing still also means the pull is parked and the pack is on you. 0 disables the check.
Heart of the Wild - Tank Buster Window6Skip the weave when the Encounter Timeline predicts a tank buster within this many seconds. Same prediction the Barkskin hold uses.
Heart of the Wild - Minimum Target TTD10Skip the weave when the target dies sooner than this. Heart of the Wild is a 120s cooldown that fires an off-role ability for the current form - Feral Frenzy in Cat - so spending it on a pack that is about to die throws the cooldown away.

Auto Combat PotionOnUse the combat potion during Incarnation/Berserk, or in the last 30 s of the fight.

Pull with Mouseover MoonfireOffOut of combat, Moonfire the enemy under your mouse to pull it. OFF by default: with it on, hovering any enemy nameplate pulls. Needs Moonfire on Mouseover.
Utility
Auto Taunt (Growl)OnGrowl your target and your mouseover when they are not on you. Never fires in a raid, where it would rip a boss off the other tank.

Soothe MouseoverOnSoothe whatever you are hovering, checked just before the current-target Soothe below. Simia cannot pick an enraged enemy by criteria — target_enemy is 'nearest enemy' with no filter and there is no .any(EXPR) for enemies — so hovering is the only way to Soothe a mob you are not targeting. Balance Mythic+

DPS · Elune's Chosen with Lunar Calling
Download .yaml All rotations

A Mythic+ Balance rotation that times the burst to the pull: it waits until the pack is gathered and dotted, opens with Fury of Elune into Incarnation, and skips cooldowns on packs that are about to die.

Build: Elune's Chosen with Lunar Calling, Incarnation, Whirling Stars, Fury of Elune, Touch the Cosmos, Fluid Form and Heart of the Wild. Copy the string from Talents → Recommended Talent String in the rotation panel.

Burst

  • The window opens when the pull is parked: you have stood still for Incarnation - Min Standing Still and Moonfire is on the whole pack (or on 10+ enemies).
  • Fury of Elune first, then Incarnation right after, even if you start moving.
  • Incarnation, Fury of Elune and Starfall are skipped when the fight will end before they pay off (Min Fight Time sliders).
  • Trinkets and the combat potion ride Incarnation.
  • With Auto Burst off you press Incarnation yourself and trinkets and potion still follow it.

Rotation

  • Single target: DoTs, Lunar Eclipse, Fury of Elune, Starsurge in Eclipse and before Astral Power caps, Touch the Cosmos procs on Starsurge, Starfire as the filler. Optional Wrath filler.
  • AoE: Starfall on Astral Power and procs, Moonfire and Sunfire spread on your mouseover (bosses are skipped), Starfire filler. Optional Swap Off a Dying Target.
  • Moving: a separate list of instants.
  • Fluid Form: Starfire puts you back into Moonkin Form; while moving it uses Moonkin Form directly.

Defense and support

  • Barkskin before a predicted hit and at low health, Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration.
  • While casting, below Emergency HP, Barkskin, healthstone and potion still fire. A cast is only cut when Panic Bear is about to follow.
  • Defensives, interrupts and dispels keep working without a valid target, for example while a boss is untargetable.
  • Heart of the Wild in Moonkin heals the whole party when someone drops low. Thorn Bloom (racial) when several allies are hurt.

Utility

  • Solar Beam on target, mouseover and focus.
  • Remove Corruption, Soothe on target and mouseover, Mark of the Wild out of combat.
  • Rebirth and Revive on the dead ally under your mouse.
  • Roots broken by shapeshifting once the current cast finishes.

A raid Balance rotation with a short ramp before every Incarnation, a Starfire-filler single target priority for Lunar Calling, and Starfall for add phases.

Burst

  • Every time an Incarnation charge is ready, an opener ramp runs: DoTs, Lunar Eclipse, Fury of Elune, then Incarnation.
  • Charges are used as they come back (Whirling Stars), so none sits capped.
  • Trinkets with Incarnation, or on cooldown when Incarnation is still more than 40 seconds away. Combat potion with Incarnation or in the last 30 seconds.

Single target

  • DoTs kept up, Lunar Eclipse, Fury of Elune.
  • Starsurge in Eclipse and before Astral Power caps; Touch the Cosmos procs go to Starsurge.
  • Starfire as the filler.

AoE

  • Starfall on Astral Power and procs, Starsurge inside Starfall.
  • Fury of Elune timed with Atmospheric Exposure (Sundered Firmament).
  • Moonfire and Sunfire spread on your mouseover during add phases.

Defense

  • Barkskin before a predicted hit and at low health.
  • Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration, plus Heart of the Wild for the max-health bear morph.
  • While casting, below Emergency HP, Barkskin and consumables still fire; a cast is only cut when Panic Bear follows.
  • Everything defensive keeps working while the boss is untargetable.

Utility

  • Solar Beam on target, mouseover and focus, Remove Corruption, Soothe, Thorn Bloom (racial), Mark of the Wild out of combat.
  • Rebirth and Revive on mouseover, roots broken by shapeshifting once the cast finishes.

Feral Mythic+

DPS · Druid of the Claw with Convoke the Spirits
Download .yaml All rotations

A Mythic+ Feral rotation that lines Berserk and Convoke up inside Tiger's Fury, keeps bleeds snapshotted, and only opens cooldowns on pulls that will live long enough.

Build: Druid of the Claw with Convoke the Spirits, Berserk, Frantic Frenzy, Primal Wrath, Rampant Ferocity, Apex Predator's Craving and Fluid Form. Copy the string from Talents → Recommended Talent String in the rotation panel.

Burst window

  • Berserk and Convoke the Spirits go out together, always inside Tiger's Fury. With Only Burst With Convoke Ready on, Berserk, trinkets and potion wait for Convoke.
  • Cooldowns wait until you have stood still for Min Seconds Standing Still and the pull will last (Min Fight Time sliders). Tiger's Fury is never held: it is the prerequisite for the whole window.
  • Trinkets in the window (or on cooldown with Trinkets Only In Burst off). The combat potion picks a window worth it: enough targets, a boss, or a long pull.

Rotation

  • Rake and Rip refreshed with a Tiger's Fury snapshot.
  • Ferocious Bite and Ravage as finishers, Primal Wrath in AoE, Swipe as the AoE builder.
  • Apex Predator's Craving procs spent right away, Frantic Frenzy inside Tiger's Fury or at low combo points.
  • Opens from Prowl with Rake.

Survival

  • Barkskin and Survival Instincts before a predicted hit and at low health.
  • Panic Bear: at very low health it shifts to Bear Form for Heart of the Wild (max health) and Frenzied Regeneration, then returns to Cat.
  • Predatory Swiftness procs become an instant Regrowth on you below the solo or group threshold.
  • Healthstone, health potion, and a hardcast Regrowth out of combat.

Utility

  • Skull Bash on target, mouseover and focus, Incapacitating Roar for AoE stops.
  • Remove Corruption, Soothe, Rebirth and Revive on mouseover.
  • Roots broken by shapeshifting, never during Convoke.

Soothe MouseoverOnSoothe whatever you are hovering, checked just before the current-target Soothe below. Simia cannot pick an enraged enemy by criteria — target_enemy is 'nearest enemy' with no filter and there is no .any(EXPR) for enemies — so hovering is the only way to Soothe a mob you are not targeting. This is an independent switch: turning Soothe Enrage off does not disable it. Guarded on mouseover.combat, so hovering an unpulled mob never pulls it.

Devourer Mythic+

DPS · Annihilator with Collapsing Star
Download .yaml All rotations

A Mythic+ Devourer rotation on the meta Annihilator build. It gathers souls, enters Void Metamorphosis the moment it can, and fills the window with Collapsing Star, Void Ray and Cull, spending Voidfall at three stacks.

Build: Annihilator with Collapsing Star, Moment of Craving, Eradicate, Star Fragments, Entropy, Emptiness, Voidpurge and Soulshaper, the AoE build most top Mythic+ players run in 12.1.5. Copy the string from Talents → Recommended Talent String in the rotation panel.

How souls work

Consume and Soul Immolation shatter Soul Fragments. Reap collects them, 4 at a time or 10 with Moment of Craving, and every soul gathered fills Void Metamorphosis. The rotation only presses Reap when it will collect a full load, so no Reap is wasted on one or two souls.

Outside Void Metamorphosis

  1. Void Metamorphosis as soon as enough souls are gathered and your target is in range.
  2. Consume when Soulburst is ready.
  3. Reap (or the empowered Eradicate) when it collects 4 or more souls on a single target, or whenever Eradicate is ready in AoE.
  4. Void Ray at 100 Fury.
  5. Reap to spend 3 Voidfall stacks.
  6. Soul Immolation on cooldown (optional, see Cooldowns).
  7. Consume as the filler.

Inside Void Metamorphosis

  1. Devour with Soulburst on a single target.
  2. Collapsing Star before the fight ends.
  3. In AoE, Void Ray first to set up Eradicate, then Collapsing Star. On a single target, Collapsing Star while Void Ray is on cooldown.
  4. Cull or Eradicate on a full load of souls.
  5. Void Ray, then Cull to spend 3 Voidfall stacks.
  6. Soul Immolation as your Fury runs out, right before Void Metamorphosis ends.
  7. Devour as the filler.

When the target is about to die, Reap collects any souls left on the ground.

Casting rules

  • Void Ray and Collapsing Star are never started while you move. Consume and Devour are cast on the move.
  • The rotation never interrupts the Void Ray channel, because Eradicate and Moment of Craving need all of it, or the Collapsing Star cast, because cancelling it loses the stored souls. Only Blur can fire during Void Ray.

Cooldowns

  • Trinkets, the combat potion and racials go out during Void Metamorphosis, or in the last 30 seconds of the fight.
  • Soul Immolation on Cooldown (on by default) uses it for damage, Fury and souls. Turn it off to keep it as a heal and for the end of Void Metamorphosis.

Defense

  • Blur before a predicted big hit, and at low health.
  • Darkness at very low health. It also protects allies standing in it.
  • Soul Immolation as a heal at low health, whatever the damage setting.
  • Healthstone and health potion at their thresholds.

Utility

  • Disrupt on target, mouseover and focus, Imprison for single stops, Void Nova and Sigil of Misery for packs, plus racial stops.
  • Consume Magic removes a magic buff from your target.
  • With Soul Cleanse talented, Soul Immolation also removes a curse from you.

This is the first version of the Devourer rotation. It follows the current SimulationCraft priority for Annihilator; tell us in Discord if something looks off in a key.

Devourer · Mythic+ v1.0.0

  • New rotation: Devourer Demon Hunter for Mythic+, on the meta Annihilator build.
  • Follows the current SimulationCraft priority: Void Metamorphosis as soon as it is ready, Collapsing Star and Void Ray inside it, Reap only on a full load of souls, Voidfall spent at 3 stacks.
  • Never cuts the Void Ray channel or the Collapsing Star cast, and never starts either while moving.

Restoration · Mythic+ v34.0.0

  • The combat potion is pressed once, and nothing else is pressed for 0.4s after it, so it no longer lands on top of the Convoke channel.
  • Healthstone and health potion are never used during Convoke or Tranquility. Barkskin is never used during Tranquility, whose channel breaks on any action; it still fires during Convoke.

Restoration · Mythic+ v33.0.0

  • The combat potion now goes out before Convoke. Convoke waits for it while it is available.

Restoration · Mythic+ v32.0.0

  • "Shift Out For Convoke" now also leaves Cat Form.
